notes.title: Update 21st Feb 21.
notes.content: Bugfixes, and Level 3 levels 1,2,3,4 is now available.

notes.title: Early Acces - Patch 0.7 on public branch
notes.content:
New content

- Tier 3 area unlocked, after completing T2_5.
- Level. T3_1 added to the game.

Audio
- Audio interactions added to all T1 and T2 levels.

Bugfixes
- Texture glitches
- "flying" kinetic items 
- Exit gate not trigggering on T2_3

Please report any bugs or errors.

notes.title: Dev branch update - 0.6e2
notes.content:
Tier 3 level T3_1 content added, but locked.
Tier 3_1 is the first actual puzzle where the game really starts.

Audio changes;
- Adjustment to walking sounds, added carpet and metal detection.
- Feedback sounds on various items when dropped or collide with other.
Added interaction sounds to level critial items on
- T1_1
- T1_2
- T1_3
- T1_4
- T1_5
- T2_1
- T2_2
- T2_3
- T2_4
- T2_5
Added audio to interactable object on 
- T1_1
- T1_2
- T1_3
- T2_1
- T2_4

Left arm Menu
- Button verifikation completed, need to add functionality for users

notes.title: Dev branch update 0.6e
notes.content:
Patch notes.

New Features
- Distance grab, pickup items at 2m range. (both left and right hands)
- Initial Menu added, triggered by MenuButton (check controller scheme)

Updated content
- T1 additional content added
- T2 additional content added

Changes
- Pixel errors modified on startarea
- missing colliders on motor in T2 added
- textures added to objects that where blank
- Physics added to moveable objects in T2

notes.title: Dev branch pushed to live, bug fixes
notes.content:
Content.
Pushed the dev branch to live due to a couple of bugs identified preventing progress.

Bugfixes:
- Fixed a door problem on T2_3
- Fixed flickering lights on T1_3
- T2 unlocks on main area after T1 completion

New content
- Added a tourch (light you can carry) for a few of the T1 levels.
- Added some decorations to T1_x levels.

Enjoy, please report any issues.

Martin.
